basic_info.description: Once upon a time in vibrant Visitation Valley, a charming single family home with an in-law unit at 46 Arleta Ave awaits its next chapter. The main house invites you with freshly painted walls and a cozy atmosphere. Imagine gathering in the spacious living room, sharing meals in the dining room, and cooking up culinary delights in the open kitchen with eat-in area. Three comfortable bedrooms provide restful retreats, while the bathroom, complete with dual sinks and a tub/shower combo, adds a touch of luxury. Step outside to a delightful backyard, perfect for entertaining or nurturing your garden dreams, and enjoy the convenience of a dedicated laundry room with washer/dryer. The In law unit, 46B, features its own entrance and address, offering endless possibilities, and is income producing. With 2 bedrooms, a well-appointed bathroom, and a kitchen filled with potential, this freshly painted space with new carpet is ready for your personal touch. Conveniently located near the freeway, Cow Palace, and Muni, this home is not just a property; it’s a canvas for your dreams. Will you be the one to write its next story?
